implemented: Observer snapshot now exposes an rdc object derived from Desktop Commander tool history.
The rdc object includes last tool, summary, age, duration, open background processes and open_count.
Chrome Observer trace-ui4 renders a Remote Desktop / background section.
MCP actor detail shows age of the most recent RDC tool observation.
TERM actor detail shows the number of open background processes.
Header remains IDLE for quiet background services but reports N background open instead of pretending nothing is running.

semantics.MCP_RDC_ACTIVE: recent observed Desktop Commander tool activity
semantics.TERM_WAITING_OPEN: process is alive but quiet; visible as background and does not make the whole Harness BUSY

limitations: Desktop Commander tool-history records a tool invocation after it completes, so a currently executing read_file/edit/write cannot be represented as START without instrumenting RDC itself.
start_process becomes observable once RDC returns its PID; the child process remains visible while alive.
